design.name: 狻猊
design.brief: The lion-dragon Suanni (one of the dragon's nine sons, guardian of incense burners) as a small stout guardian lion-dog: a big round head with a huge curly mane carved in jade-green and teal swirls, bulging round eyes, a wide grinning mouth with small fangs, a stocky body in dark aged bronze (the dark colour block), curly flame-like tufts at the elbows, a thick curly tail, a small round bronze incense burner (ding) with three tiny legs sitting on its back like a saddle with a wisp of glowing incense ember, and a red silk ribbon with a bronze bell on its chest. Proud and protective; shown roaring with its mouth wide open.
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing pose on all four legs
design.turnaround_pose: , legs straight and slightly apart, head facing forward, mouth closed in a grin, the curly tail raised behind the incense burner but clearly separate from it
design.turnaround_digits: each paw shows four separate clawed toes; the mane, burner and tail are never cut off by the frame.
